kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستقيئ (form X)
# أَسْتَقْيِئُ (ʔastaqyiʔu) /ʔas.taq.ji.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْيَأَ (istaqyaʔa)
# أَسْتَقْيِئَ (ʔastaqyiʔa) /ʔas.taq.ji.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقْيَأَ (istaqyaʔa)
# أَسْتَقْيِئْ (ʔastaqyiʔ) /ʔas.taq.jiʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَقْيَأَ (istaqyaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
